about.body: Located in Main Bazar, every cake is created to feel personal, polished, and occasion-ready. From everyday fresh cakes to detailed custom themes, the focus is always on softness, freshness, and elegant presentation.

items.question: Do you make eggless cakes?
items.answer: Yes. Sunil Bakers offers eggless celebration cakes with the same focus on softness, richness, and presentation.

items.question: How early should I enquire for a theme cake?
items.answer: Advance discussion is best for custom themes so colors, message details, and finishing can be planned properly.

items.question: Can names, toppers, and custom writing be added?
items.answer: Yes. Share the name, occasion, preferred colors, and inspiration so the cake can be tailored for the event.

items.question: How is custom pricing decided?
items.answer: Final pricing depends on size, flavor, eggless preference, finishing detail, and theme complexity.

items.question: Is pickup possible for local orders?
items.answer: Yes. Customers can call or WhatsApp to confirm handover timing and availability for local celebrations.

items.question: What details should I send for a fast quotation?
items.answer: Send the cake type, occasion, flavor, date needed, eggless preference, and theme idea for the fastest response.
